answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 41 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a willow bet on surviving 41 epochs of grading, and every mesa settlement recomputes the ridge schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 7 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
